purpose: Qualify native session affinity before AgentX. Header/session field already exists; no new router, kernel, dependency or replay semantics.

coverage: explicit rank precedence and absent-session load balance

live_controls.compare: All cached/uncached branch choices and logprobs on matching API batch lists, same server/rank; record per-engine cache query/hit deltas to prove routing. Internal execution shapes not asserted.

engineering_value.bottleneck: C32 actual prefix hits39.58%, per-rank22-52%, while native DP ignores stable session ID.
engineering_value.gain_hypothesis: Raising hits from40% to60% would cut computed prompt tokens by one third; no end-to-end gain follows until measured. Capacity and hash imbalance can limit reuse.
engineering_value.implementation: Ten added lines in the native DP selector, using the existing session field and stable CRC32 as the existing late-interaction route does. No server config/API schema addition.
engineering_value.validation: CPU selection/completion regression, live same-rank fixed-history cache/state comparisons and per-rank counters, then full native AgentX at matched load.
engineering_value.maintenance: One upstream-owned method and a focused test; no new service or routing subsystem.
